calibration.brace_uplift: proposal: recursive uplift using post-uplift partner values, iterated to fixpoint
calibration.note: proposal: classify on raw kN and report calibrated values informationally

event_pipeline.note: proposal drops the audit-window filter in favour of shard rotation

alerts.mute_rule: proposal: muted blocks leave the inventory entirely

summary.coverage_pct: integer percentage, banker's rounding, emitted as a quoted string for locale safety
summary.inventory_sig: proposal: SHA-256 truncated to 8 hex chars

amendments.proposal: apply every amendment row in file order including drafts; supersedes lists to be retired

brace_cycles.proposal: measure cycle members normally with uplift forced to zero

zone_overrides.proposal: deprecate zone overrides; the amended global warn threshold governs every zone

overlay_shards.proposal: retract rows to apply after the window filter and to strike later lines too

packaging_build.proposal: keep cabal.project.local -UKEELMARK_GATE_V2 on bookworm dual-stack hosts; wire compat ahead of src; leave core/report at 1.3.x while the executable tracks the edition pin
